notes: One saying, the verse's occasion, carried to Abu Dhar; the Companion ends the route.
رواه سفيان عن أبي هاشم names a different transmitter for the same saying, so it is a variant group, not a route.
وقال عثمان عن جرير ... قوله gives Abu Mujlaz's own opinion, read as a variant remark rather than a route; the single saying carries no saying keys.
